blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解先進療法醫藥品 (ATMP) 的定義與臨床重要性，以及基因治療在現代醫療中所扮演的角色。
blocks.en: Understand the definition and clinical importance of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) and the role gene therapy plays in modern medicine.

blocks.zh: 能夠區分病毒載體 (viral vectors) 與質體 DNA (plasmid DNA) 在 ATMP 製造鏈中的不同功能與地位。
blocks.en: Be able to distinguish the different functions and positions of viral vectors and plasmid DNA in the ATMP manufacturing chain.

blocks.zh: 掌握本文件的適用範圍：涵蓋體內 (in vivo) 與體外 (ex vivo) 兩種病毒載體應用情境。
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of this document: it covers both in vivo and ex vivo applications of viral vectors.

blocks.zh: 了解 PDA PtC-11 以科學驅動、風險為本方法 (science-driven, risk-based approach) 為核心主軸，及其與 EU GMP Annex 1、PIC/S Annex 2A 等法規框架的關聯。
blocks.en: Understand that PDA PtC-11 is built around a science-driven, risk-based approach, and how it relates to regulatory frameworks such as EU GMP Annex 1 and PIC/S Annex 2A.

blocks.zh: 認識文件所涵蓋的七大主題領域，並理解為什麼這些主題對 CDMO CMC 專業人員具有實務價值。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the seven topic areas covered by the document, and understand why they are of practical value to CDMO CMC professionals.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 什麼是 ATMP？
blocks.en: Core Concepts: What Is an ATMP?

blocks.zh: 先進療法醫藥品 (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products, ATMP) 是歐盟法規框架（EC Regulation 1394/2007）所定義的三大類特殊治療品的總稱：
blocks.en: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) is the collective term for three categories of specialized therapeutic products defined in the EU regulatory framework (EC Regulation 1394/2007):

blocks.zh: 基因治療藥品 (Gene Therapy Medicinal Products, GTMP)：透過引入治療性基因序列，修正、替換、或抑制異常基因功能。
blocks.en: Gene Therapy Medicinal Products (GTMPs): introduce a therapeutic gene sequence to correct, replace, or suppress the function of an abnormal gene.

blocks.zh: 體細胞治療藥品 (Somatic Cell Therapy Medicinal Products, SCTMP)：使用在體外經過操控的活細胞或組織作為治療劑。
blocks.en: Somatic Cell Therapy Medicinal Products (SCTMPs): use living cells or tissues that have been manipulated ex vivo as the therapeutic agent.

blocks.zh: 組織工程製品 (Tissue Engineered Products, TEP)：含有或由細胞/組織構成，具再生、修復或替換人體組織功能。
blocks.en: Tissue Engineered Products (TEPs): contain or consist of cells/tissues and are intended to regenerate, repair, or replace human tissue.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 聚焦於 GTMP 中使用病毒載體 (viral vectors) 和質體 DNA (plasmid DNA, pDNA) 的部分。
blocks.en: PtC-11 focuses on the part of GTMPs that uses viral vectors and plasmid DNA (pDNA).

blocks.zh: 病毒載體與質體 DNA 的關係：質體 DNA 是製造病毒載體的「原料」（building blocks），就像零件之於成品機器。pDNA 先在細菌細胞中大量擴增，再被引入哺乳動物細胞中，幫助組裝出完整的病毒載體顆粒。因此，pDNA 的品質直接影響最終病毒載體（即藥物活性成分）的品質。
blocks.en: The relationship between viral vectors and plasmid DNA: plasmid DNA is the "raw material" (building block) for making viral vectors, like parts to a finished machine. pDNA is first amplified in large quantities in bacterial cells and then introduced into mammalian cells, where it helps assemble complete viral vector particles. The quality of the pDNA therefore directly affects the quality of the final viral vector (that is, the drug substance).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 病毒載體：治療基因的「快遞員」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Viral Vector as a "Courier" for the Therapeutic Gene

blocks.zh: 想像你需要把一封重要的信（治療性基因）送進城堡（患者的細胞）裡。城堡的城牆（細胞膜）非常堅固，普通方法根本進不去。這時候你需要一位特殊的「信使」——他不僅能穿過城牆，還能確保信件被正確交到收件人手中。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to deliver an important letter (the therapeutic gene) into a castle (the patient's cell). The castle walls (the cell membrane) are very strong, and ordinary methods cannot get through. You need a special "messenger" who can not only cross the wall but also make sure the letter is handed to the right recipient.

blocks.zh: 病毒載體就是這個「信使快遞員」。大自然演化出的病毒，天生就有感染細胞的能力。科學家將病毒改造後，移除其致病的危險基因，保留其「進入細胞」的能力，再裝入治療性基因，就形成了病毒載體。
blocks.en: A viral vector is this "messenger courier". Viruses that evolved in nature are born with the ability to infect cells. Scientists modify a virus by removing its dangerous disease-causing genes and keeping its ability to "enter cells", then load it with the therapeutic gene, which creates a viral vector.

blocks.zh: 質體 DNA 則像是快遞公司的「生產指令手冊」——用來製造這些快遞員的藍圖。品質差的手冊，會導致製造出瑕疵品快遞員，無法準確送達信件。
blocks.en: Plasmid DNA is like the courier company's "production instruction manual", the blueprint used to make these couriers. A poor-quality manual leads to defective couriers that cannot deliver the letter accurately.

blocks.zh: AAV（腺相關病毒）擅長進入神經、肌肉等非分裂細胞；Lentivirus（慢病毒）則能整合入分裂中的免疫細胞（如 T 細胞），特別適合製造 CAR-T 細胞療法。
blocks.en: AAV (adeno-associated virus) is good at entering non-dividing cells such as neurons and muscle; lentivirus can integrate into dividing immune cells (such as T cells), which makes it especially suitable for producing CAR-T cell therapies.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — PtC-11 不是法規標準！
blocks.en: Key Point: PtC-11 Is Not a Regulatory Standard!

blocks.zh: 文件明確聲明：「It does not represent a standard or a regulatory guidance.」
blocks.en: The document states explicitly: "It does not represent a standard or a regulatory guidance."

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 專業人員而言，這是極為重要的理解前提：
blocks.en: For CDMO professionals, this is an essential premise to understand:

blocks.zh: PtC-11 是 PDA 彙集多位 CMC 產業專家意見所形成的「最佳實務建議」，代表產業共識，而非法規要求。
blocks.en: PtC-11 is a set of "best practice recommendations" compiled by PDA from the input of multiple CMC industry experts. It represents industry consensus, not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 法規查核員不會依本文件直接開具 Warning Letter；但文件中所引用的 EU GMP Annex 1、PIC/S Annex 2A、FDA CMC Guidance 才是具法律效力的規範。
blocks.en: Regulatory inspectors will not issue a Warning Letter directly on the basis of this document; the legally binding requirements are the EU GMP Annex 1, PIC/S Annex 2A, and FDA CMC guidance documents that it cites.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應將本文件視為「思考框架」與「對話起點」，與客戶（MAH）討論策略時可引用，但提交法規文件時應以官方指引為依據。
blocks.en: A CDMO should treat this document as a "thinking framework" and a "starting point for discussion". It can be cited when discussing strategy with the client (MAH), but regulatory submissions should be based on the official guidance.

blocks.zh: 本文件補充、而非取代 PDA TR 81（細胞療法控制策略）及其他現有 PDA 技術報告。
blocks.en: This document supplements, rather than replaces, PDA TR 81 (control strategy for cell therapy) and other existing PDA technical reports.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 視角：為何 ATMP 製造能力攸關策略地位？
blocks.en: Practical Application, CDMO Perspective: Why Does ATMP Manufacturing Capability Matter Strategically?

blocks.zh: ATMP 市場正在快速成長。截至 2025 年，全球已有超過 30 個 ATMP 產品獲批，臨床管線中有逾千個候選品。對於 CDMO 而言，搶先建立 ATMP 製造能力具有顯著的商業意義：
blocks.en: The ATMP market is growing rapidly. As of 2025, more than 30 ATMP products have been approved worldwide, with over a thousand candidates in the clinical pipeline. For a CDMO, building ATMP manufacturing capability early has significant commercial meaning:

blocks.zh: 高門檻即護城河：病毒載體製造技術複雜（需 BSL-2 生物安全等級廠房、懸浮細胞培養、超速離心純化），並非所有 CDMO 都有能力承接，先進入者享有稀缺溢價。
blocks.en: High barriers are a moat: viral vector manufacturing is technically complex (it requires BSL-2 biosafety-level facilities, suspension cell culture, and ultracentrifugation purification), and not every CDMO is able to take it on; early entrants enjoy a scarcity premium.

blocks.zh: 黏性高：ATMP 客戶一旦選定 CDMO，往往難以輕易轉換（技術轉移成本高、法規申請繁複），長期訂單比率高於小分子藥品。
blocks.en: High stickiness: once an ATMP client selects a CDMO, switching is often difficult (technology transfer is costly and regulatory filings are complex), so the share of long-term orders is higher than for small-molecule drugs.

blocks.zh: 監管風險需主動管理：pDNA 和病毒載體的分類（raw material vs. drug substance）在不同法規轄區有差異（後續 Topic 1 深度討論），CDMO 若未能理解這些差異，可能為客戶帶來不必要的法規風險。
blocks.en: Regulatory risk needs proactive management: the classification of pDNA and viral vectors (raw material vs. drug substance) differs between regulatory jurisdictions (discussed in depth in Topic 1 later). A CDMO that fails to understand these differences may expose its clients to unnecessary regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: TR 81 ＋ PtC-11 是雙軌必讀：熟悉兩份文件的 CMC 人員，能為客戶提供更完整的策略建議，是差異化競爭的優勢來源。
blocks.en: TR 81 + PtC-11 is dual-track required reading: CMC staff who are familiar with both documents can give clients more complete strategic advice, which is a source of competitive differentiation.

blocks.zh: Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 文件的七大主題領域
blocks.en: Core Concepts: The Seven Topic Areas of the Document

blocks.zh: PtC-11 以問答格式（Q&A format）組織內容，涵蓋以下七個主題，每個主題都呼應了 ATMP CMC 開發中的真實挑戰：
blocks.en: PtC-11 organizes its content in a Q&A format covering the following seven topics, each of which reflects a real challenge in ATMP CMC development:

blocks.zh: Topic 1 — 分類 (Categorization)：病毒載體是原料、關鍵起始原料、還是活性藥物成分 (drug substance)？不同監管轄區答案不同。
blocks.en: Topic 1 - Categorization: is a viral vector a raw material, a critical starting material, or a drug substance? The answer differs between regulatory jurisdictions.

blocks.zh: Topic 2 — QbD 品質源於設計：如何將 QTPP 和 CQA 的概念套用到病毒載體和 pDNA 的開發？
blocks.en: Topic 2 - QbD (Quality by Design): how can the concepts of QTPP and CQA be applied to the development of viral vectors and pDNA?

blocks.zh: Topic 3 — 控制策略 (Control Strategy)：微生物控制、製程中管控 (IPC)、及整體品質控制體系的建立。
blocks.en: Topic 3 - Control Strategy: microbial control, in-process controls (IPC), and establishing an overall quality control system.

blocks.zh: Topic 4 — 過濾 (Filtration)：無菌過濾對 AAV/LV 的衝擊，以及奈米過濾用於去除病毒污染物的考量。
blocks.en: Topic 4 - Filtration: the impact of sterile filtration on AAV/LV, and considerations for nanofiltration used to remove viral contaminants.

blocks.zh: Topic 5 — 可比性 (Comparability)：製程變更後如何證明產品品質不受影響。
blocks.en: Topic 5 - Comparability: how to demonstrate that product quality is not affected after a process change.

blocks.zh: Topic 6 — 平台技術 (Platform Technologies)：如何利用平台策略提高跨品種 ATMP 製造的效率與一致性。
blocks.en: Topic 6 - Platform Technologies: how to use a platform strategy to improve the efficiency and consistency of manufacturing across different ATMP products.

blocks.zh: Topic 7 — 效力測定 (Potency Assays)：如何設計並階段性導入產品專屬的效力測試。
blocks.en: Topic 7 - Potency Assays: how to design product-specific potency tests and introduce them in a phased manner.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — In Vivo vs. Ex Vivo：兩種「投遞策略」
blocks.en: Analogy: In Vivo vs. Ex Vivo, Two "Delivery Strategies"

blocks.zh: 基因治療的投遞方式，可類比為兩種截然不同的物流模型：
blocks.en: The delivery approaches of gene therapy can be compared to two quite different logistics models:

blocks.zh: In Vivo（體內基因治療）——「直接快遞到戶」：病毒載體直接注射進患者體內，如同包裹直送到收件人家門口。載體在患者體內自行尋找目標細胞並完成基因轉送。AAV 是最常見的體內基因治療載體（例如治療脊髓性肌肉萎縮症的 Zolgensma）。
blocks.en: In vivo (gene therapy inside the body) - "direct delivery to the door": the viral vector is injected directly into the patient's body, like a parcel delivered straight to the recipient's doorstep. The vector finds the target cells on its own inside the patient and completes the gene transfer. AAV is the most common vector for in vivo gene therapy (for example, Zolgensma, used to treat spinal muscular atrophy).

blocks.zh: Ex Vivo（體外基因修飾）——「工廠加工後再出貨」：先從患者身上抽取細胞（如 T 細胞），在體外實驗室中用病毒載體修改細胞的基因，確認加工品質後，再回輸到患者體內。CAR-T 細胞療法（如 Kymriah、Yescarta）就是典型的 ex vivo 模型。慢病毒 (Lentivirus) 是最常用的 ex vivo 改造載體，因為它能將目標基因整合進分裂中的 T 細胞基因組。
blocks.en: Ex vivo (gene modification outside the body) - "processed at the factory, then shipped": cells (such as T cells) are first collected from the patient, their genes are modified with a viral vector in a laboratory outside the body, and after the quality of the processed cells is confirmed, they are infused back into the patient. CAR-T cell therapies (such as Kymriah and Yescarta) are the typical ex vivo model. Lentivirus is the most commonly used vector for ex vivo modification because it can integrate the target gene into the genome of dividing T cells.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 的範疇同時涵蓋這兩種模型，因此內容對不同 ATMP 業務類型的 CDMO 皆具參考價值。
blocks.en: The scope of PtC-11 covers both models, so its content is a useful reference for CDMOs in different types of ATMP business.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 科學驅動、風險為本：貫穿全文的核心哲學
blocks.en: Key Point: Science-Driven and Risk-Based, the Core Philosophy Throughout the Document

blocks.zh: 「Science-driven and risk-based approach（科學驅動、風險為本的方法）」是 PtC-11 反覆強調的核心思路，也是當前所有先進療法法規指引的共同基調：
blocks.en: "Science-driven and risk-based approach" is the central line of thinking that PtC-11 emphasizes repeatedly, and it is the common tone of all current advanced therapy regulatory guidance:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（無菌藥品製造）和其附屬的風險為本方法指引，要求廠商從科學依據設計組織性、技術性和結構性的 GMP 合規措施。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (manufacture of sterile medicinal products) and its associated risk-based approach guidance require manufacturers to design organizational, technical, and structural GMP compliance measures based on scientific rationale.

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 2A（ATMP 製造）特別指出，品質風險管理 (Quality Risk Management, QRM) 原則對這類材料尤為重要，直接呼應 ICH Q9。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 2A (manufacture of ATMPs) specifically points out that Quality Risk Management (QRM) principles are especially important for these materials, directly echoing ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實務意義：當監管指引無法提供明確答案時（ATMP 領域常有此情況），風險評估文件（risk assessment）本身就是合規的基礎。能夠清楚記錄「為什麼這樣做是科學合理的」，比單純遵循固定程序更為重要。
blocks.en: Practical significance for a CDMO: when regulatory guidance does not provide a clear answer (often the case in the ATMP field), the risk assessment document itself becomes the basis of compliance. Being able to clearly document "why this approach is scientifically justified" matters more than simply following a fixed procedure.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家客戶正在開發 AAV 載體用於體內 (in vivo) 脊髓性肌肉萎縮症基因治療，並且同時希望在美國和歐盟申請臨床試驗。請問這個 AAV 載體在兩個監管轄區中各屬於什麼分類（raw material、starting material、critical starting material、還是 drug substance）？這對 CDMO 的品管要求有何影響？
blocks.en: A client is developing an AAV vector for in vivo spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy and wants to apply for clinical trials in both the US and the EU. How would this AAV vector be classified in each of the two regulatory jurisdictions (raw material, starting material, critical starting material, or drug substance)? How does this affect the CDMO's quality control requirements?

blocks.zh: PtC-11 明確表示「不代表標準或法規指引」，那麼在實際工作中，你會如何向客戶解釋引用 PtC-11 建議的意義與限制？在哪些情境下引用它最能為客戶帶來價值？
blocks.en: PtC-11 states explicitly that it "does not represent a standard or a regulatory guidance". In actual work, how would you explain to a client the meaning and limitations of citing PtC-11 recommendations? In which situations would citing it bring the most value to the client?

blocks.zh: 質體 DNA (pDNA) 被稱為病毒載體製造的「building blocks」。試想如果 pDNA 的品質出現波動（例如超螺旋比例下降、殘留內毒素升高），對最終 AAV 藥品的哪些關鍵品質屬性 (CQA) 可能產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: Plasmid DNA (pDNA) is described as the "building blocks" of viral vector manufacturing. If pDNA quality fluctuates (for example, a lower supercoiled fraction or higher residual endotoxin), which critical quality attributes (CQAs) of the final AAV drug product could be affected, and how?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ATMP 包含細胞治療、基因治療及組織工程製品；PtC-11 聚焦於使用病毒載體（AAV、Lentivirus）和質體 DNA (pDNA) 的基因治療。
blocks.en: ATMPs include cell therapies, gene therapies, and tissue engineered products; PtC-11 focuses on gene therapies that use viral vectors (AAV, lentivirus) and plasmid DNA (pDNA).

blocks.zh: 病毒載體是治療性基因的「遞送工具」，可用於體內直接投藥 (in vivo) 或體外細胞改造後回輸 (ex vivo，如 CAR-T)；pDNA 是製造病毒載體的關鍵起始原料，其品質直接影響最終產品品質。
blocks.en: A viral vector is the "delivery tool" for the therapeutic gene and can be used by direct administration in the body (in vivo) or for modifying cells outside the body and infusing them back (ex vivo, such as CAR-T); pDNA is a key starting material for making viral vectors, and its quality directly affects the quality of the final product.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 涵蓋七大主題：分類、QbD、控制策略、過濾、可比性、平台技術、效力測定，以問答格式呈現，是產業最佳實務建議，而非法規標準。
blocks.en: PtC-11 covers seven topics: categorization, QbD, control strategy, filtration, comparability, platform technologies, and potency assays. It is presented in a Q&A format and is industry best practice recommendation, not a regulatory standard.

blocks.zh: 貫穿全文的核心哲學是「科學驅動、風險為本」，與 EU GMP Annex 1、PIC/S Annex 2A 及 ICH Q9 的精神一致，是 CDMO 在面對法規模糊地帶時最重要的決策依據。
blocks.en: The core philosophy throughout the document is "science-driven, risk-based", consistent with the spirit of EU GMP Annex 1, PIC/S Annex 2A, and ICH Q9, and is the most important basis for decisions when a CDMO faces regulatory gray areas.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 補充而非取代 PDA TR 81（細胞療法控制策略）及其他現有 PDA 技術報告，CMC 專業人員應將二者搭配閱讀。
blocks.en: PtC-11 supplements rather than replaces PDA TR 81 (control strategy for cell therapy) and other existing PDA technical reports; CMC professionals should read the two together.
